Information
Points to Master: 15000
Passive: Toggle

"Asmodeus is in truth, the ability to subdue and enslave life itself" 

Passive

[Passive, Toggle] Life Domination: Consumption - The user is able to heal themselves for a percentage of physical damage they deal.

[Passive, In-Slot] Life Domination: Pain Amplification - The user is able to bypass resistances and degrades nullifications to resistances.

[Passive, True] Life Domination: Superior Life Force - The user cannot have their Energy drained by an attack from a player that has less than 75% of their EP. Any draining effects on the user are cut in half. (75% when mastered)

Actives

[Active, In-Slot] Re-Birth - When this mode is in-slot, the user's subordinates, when killed, will leave behind their Soul. You can use this ability while looking at the target to revive them.

[Active, Hold] Life Domination: Seduction - When held the user begins to deal 1% of the target's SHP every second, if Seduction is used to reduce their SHP to 30% or lower, they become Charmed.

[Active, Press} Life Domination: Embracing Drain - Requires the player to be looking at a mob and be within 3 blocks. Locks the player and the mob in place and drains 500 (2.5% with Mastery) MP and AP per second. Lasts for a total of 5 seconds. Causes pain effects even with resistance/nullification. Cost 1,000 MP.

[Active, Press] Life Domination: Arousal - When used while not looking at a mob or when sneaking, fully heals the player and removes all status effects. When looking at a mob while sneaking, fully heals them and removes all status effects [Cost 40 MP (20 with Mastery) per HP and 20 MP per effect level]. If used on a mob that can breed while its at full hp, will cause them to enter hearts mode. This ability when mastered can be used to reset a mob's breeding timer.

[Active, Hold] Death Blessing - When holding down, a pair of divine hands reaching from the sky toward the position/target that the user is looking at (in 14 block range), while being casted, every entities in 6x6 block radius around the targeted position are slowed down by 80%. Once reaching 4s casted, all of the affected entities are instantly killed if their EP is lower than 65% of the player's and restores the player's expended MP and AP by the target mobs EP (75/25). If the target is between 65% and 95% Drains 25% EP and deals half their HP in damage. If above 95% drains 5% and deals half their HP in damage. Cost 170,500 MP - 5s cooldown.

[Active, In-Slot] Memory End Requiem - While this mode is in slot, the user drains the life force of anyone they strike, to various degrees based off several factors. This art does have a 7 Second Cooldown.

If the target has less than 30% of your EP, this skill will drain 80% of their Magicules and Aura in a single strike.

The the target has less than 50% of your EP, this skill will drain 60% of their Magicules and Aura in a single strike.

The the target has less than 70% of your EP, this skill will drain 40% of their Magicules and Aura in a single strike.

The the target has less than 50% of your EP and has no Ultimate Skill, this will drain 99% of their Magicules and Aura in a single strike.

Information
Points to Master: 5000
Passive: Toggle

Passive

[Passive, True] Fallen Lord - The user becomes a Majin Alignment, however they take 15% less damage from Holy and Spiritual. The user gains the Extra Skill Hand of Creation and Hand Of Destruction

[Passive, In-Slot ] Phantasmal Style - Applies an effect that deals 2.5% of the target's spiritual HP (5 when mastered) to the user's attacks. The user also has a chance of applying a level of Drowsiness to the target, (15% Chance, 30 when mastered), up to level 8. The user increases the Spiritual Damage they do by 50 for every level of Drowsiness the target has.

[Passive, Toggle] Duality of Understanding - The user gains +15 Mastery and Learning Speed.

Active

[Active, Inslot/Press] Fallen Edge - The user can shift press this to swap between Fallen Catastrophe and Fallen Strike mode.

Fallen Catastrophe - The user can attacks a target, and instantly kills any target that doesn't check 2/3 of the conditions. If 2/3 conditions are met, it gives them drowsiness 5, if 3/3 are met, it gives them 4 instead. Spiritual Attack Resistance or Nullification. Greater than 30% of the user's EP. Has an ultimate skill. This has a 15 second cooldown

Fallen Strike - The user's attacks deal 2.5% of the target's spiritual health damage (5% when mastered). This stacks with Phantasmal Style. Any target that doesn't possess an Ultimate Skill will be instantly killed upon their Spriitual HP reaching 30% of lower.

[Active, Held] Fallen Slumber - The user can shift press this to swap between Fallen Thanatos and True Sleep.

Fallen Thanatos - The target the all nearby entities are given Drowsiness every 7 seconds. Any nearby entities that have Drowsiness 10 near the user while Fallen Slumber is held, are killed.

Fallen Sleep - The user holds this button and dozes off, while held they're unable to move, attack or use any abilities, but begin to regenerate 100 HP and SHP (+25% when mastered) a second, and they increase the user's MP and AP regeneration by 150x. If MP is at max, it will begin to create stored MP. If the user has more than 500,000 stored MP, they begin to regenerate the MP of nearby allies by 5,000 MP a second.

[Active, Press] Fallen World - The User can Shift use this ability to swap between Modes.

World of Nightmares - When this mode is used, the user pulls all nearby targets into the Fallen World. While in this Fallen World, the user is immune to all Physical Damage, and Illusion Clones of the user are spawn around the victims of the World of Nightmares. When your Illusion Clones are attacked, they explode and deal 500 Spiritual Damage to their attacker.

World of Ruination - When this mode is used, the user pulls all nearby targets into the Fallen World. The World of Ruination prevents any of its victims from being able to heal inside of it. Inside of the World of Ruination, the user's Fallen Lord status also allows them to increase their Holy and Spiritual Damage Reduction to 50% and increase their Holy and Spiritual Damage by +50.

World of Creation - When this mode is used, the user's Magicule Regeneration is boosted massively, regenerating 15% of their Magicules per second.

Information
Points to Master: 5000
Passive: Toggle

Passive

[Passive, True] Heavenly Lord - The user becomes a Holy alignment. The user is considered Divine.

[Passive, Toggle] Designer's Plan - The user gains +12 Mastery and Learning Speed.

Active

[Active,Press] Skill Evolution - When Pressed, the user opens up the Skill Designer GUI which will contain the various Skill Evolution options. Each Evolution option has various MP costs per. Skill Evolutions MP cost to attempt is offten equal to the Total MP of possible Skills, sometimes x2.

[Active, Press] Recycle - When Pressed, the user opens the Recycle GUI and can delete any of the skills they own for its Magicule Cost. There is a 15% Chance (20% when mastered) to get 10% more MP (20% when mastered) than the skills original cost.

[Active, Held] Magicule Furnace - When held, the user begins to generate Magicules, restoring 5% (7% when mastered). The user can generate current Magicules up to 250% of the user's Max Magicules.

[Active, Press] True Apocrypha - When pressed, the user toggles on the Apocrypha state, as the user begins to lose Magicules at 8% (6% when mastered) every two seconds. The user boosts their Attack Damage by 30 (60 when mastered) and armor by 35 (70 when mastered). While Apocrypha is active, the user bypasses Physical Attack Nullification.

[Active, Held] Divine Darkness - When held, the user fires a beam that deals 100 Holy and 100 Darkness Damage. (250 when mastered) a second and cost 3.5% MP per second fire. If the user Shift Presses this, it instead fires off a Divine Darkness Barrage and fires off twelve beams instead.

Information
Passive: Toggle

"Insert Rheinhardt quote here" 

Passives

[Passive, True] Spiritual Blessing - The user becomes Blessed and a Holy Being.

Actives

[Active, Press] Blessing Creation - This is similar to the Gift Creation, however the user can produce skills from a larger list. Shift Use to open a GUI allowing the deletion of Blessings

[Active, Press] Blessing Bestowal - The user can bestow one of the Blessings they can create as a skill to a subordinate.

[Active, In-Slot] Divine Protection - This mode when in slot gives the user the effects of the Divine Blessing or Boon they made.

[Active, In-Slot] Sword Saint - While a sword is held, the user gains dodge chance negation of 50% and critical hit chance of 100%.

[Active, Press] Sword Saint - This will engrave a weapon with Holy Weapon or improve the Holy Weapon engravement up to level 3.

The additional Blessing obtainable are:

Phoenix Blessing

Phoenix Next

Death God

Sword Saint

Information
Passive: Toggle

"Your Skills will have no effect against me" 

Passive

[Passive, True] Deep Storage - The user is unable to have their skills copied or plundered. The user gains three additional skill slots. (Default Keybinds: F, G, H)

Actives

[Active, Press] Skill Creation - When used, the player can select one Unique Skill or Anti-Skill to create. They will have this Unique Skill under the exchange it for a new one. When Astral Light is mastered, it is able to produce Ultimate Skills.

[Active, Press] Directive Imprint - When used, the player can select a skill they have created to imprint it with an "Ego". This Ego-Imprinted skill becomes permanent skill until the Directive Imprint is reused and the Ego is placed into another skill.

Skills under Directive Imprint will always be considered as if it was in-slot.

[Active, In-Slot] Tachyon Processing - While this mode is In-Slot, the user gains +25 Mastery and +25 Learning.

[Active, Hold] Bodily Recreation - When held, after sixty seconds and slowly draining 5,000 MP a second, the user will forcefully evolve their race. This will have a long cooldown.

[Active, Press] Material Creation - The user opens a Menu that lists all of the materials they've learned, and allows them to create them, by expending their Magicules. This takes Maximum Magicules away from the user for everything made. On Shift Use it will insted begin learning the item in hand or block the user is looking at.

[Active, Press] Control - When used, the user swaps control of their body over to the Wise Ego. The Wise Ego is capable of fighting and killing threats.
